title: Import Analyzer by Product and Period
description: Identify the top importers for specific product types and detail exactly what they're importing over a given period of time.
prompt_template: Analyze the market for {{product_type}} and provide a detailed breakdown of the {{top_x_number}} major importers over the last {{time_period}}. For each importer, identify the specific product types they import within the category {{category}}
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the following schema: [ { "clave": "string (importer's name)", "valor": "array of strings (imported product types)" } ]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Import Volume Analysis
description: Provide a quick, structured overview of the import landscape for a specific product.
prompt_template: Analyze the market for {{product_type}} and provide a detailed breakdown of the {{top_x_number}} major importers over the last {{time_period}}. For each importer, identify the import volume in {{metric}}
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the following schema: [ { "clave": "string (importer's name)", "valor": "corresponding import volume and metric" } ]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Analysis of a product's import value
description: Provide the information on the import value of a specific product from the top X largest importers over a defined period of time.
prompt_template: Analyze the market for {{product_type}} and provide a detailed breakdown of the {{top_x_number}} major importers over the last {{time_period}}. For each importer, identify the import volume and their corresponding value in {{metric}}
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the following schema: [ {  "clave": "string (importer's name)", "valor": "import value with the specificated metric" } ].If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Distributor-Customer Relationships
description: Analyze the nature and strength of the relationships between the distributor and its customers.
prompt_template: Analyze the distributor-customer relationships of {{distributor_name}} in {{country}}, operating in the {{industry}} sector. Classify the interactions with customers into three categories: Strong, Medium, or Weak, based on factors such as contractual agreements, loyalty, and use of direct vs. indirect channels. For each category, provide the relative percentage of customers or sales they represent.
output_format: Return only a JSON dictionary with one key 'relationships' and its value as an array of objects [{"clave": "strength", "valor": "relative percent"}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise..

title: Segment Mix Analysis
description: Show the distribution of the distributor's customers across different market segments.
prompt_template: Analyze the segment mix of {{distributor_name}} in {{country}}, within the {{industry}} industry. Identify the main market segments served (e.g., healthcare, retail, food service, manufacturing) and provide their relative percentages.
output_format: Return only a JSON dictionary with one key 'segment_mix' and its value as an array of objects [{"clave": "segment", "valor": 0}].If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Customer Mix Analysis
description: Identify the main types of customers served by the distributor and their relative proportions.
prompt_template: Analyze the customer mix of {{distributor_name}} in {{country}}, within the {{industry}} industry. Identify the main customer categories (e.g., retailers, wholesalers, end-consumers, industrial buyers) and estimate their relative shares.
output_format: Return only a JSON dictionary with one key 'customer_mix' and its value as an array of objects [{"clave":"category", "value": 0}].If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Import-Domestic Mix Analysis
description: Explain the balance between imported and locally sourced products handled by the distributor.
prompt_template: Analyze the import-domestic mix of {{distributor_name}} in {{country}}, within the {{industry}} industry. Provide the approximate percentage split between imported and domestically sourced products.
output_format: Return only a JSON dictionary with one key 'import_domestic_mix' and its value as an object {"imported": 0, "domestic": 0}.If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Historical evolution and demand projection
description: Analyze the historical and future evolution of demand over the last 5 years and projections for the next 5 years.
prompt_template: Analyze the historical evolution and future projection of the demand for the product or service {{product_or_service}} of the company {{company_name}} in {{country}}, within the {{industry}} industry. Provide annual data for the last 5 years and the next 5 years.
output_format: Return only a JSON array with the format: [{"clave": "Year -5", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year -4", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year -3", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year -2", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year -1", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Current Year", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year +1", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year +2", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year +3", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year +4", "valor": 0}, {"clave": "Year +5", "valor": 0}].If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: New Products
description: Analyze the main product and opportunities for new options in the market.
prompt_template: Analyze the {{main_product}} and its evolution in the market. Identify opportunities to develop {{new_options}}, evaluating the interest in {{target_market}}. Rank the options based on {{prioritization_criteria}}.
output_format: Return only a JSON array with the format: [{"option": "Option 1", "rank": 1, "value": 0},{"option": "Option 2", "rank": 2, "value": 0},{"option": "Option 3", "rank": 3, "value": 0}].If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: New Customers
description: Evaluate opportunities to expand the product towards new customer segments.
prompt_template: Evaluate the expansion opportunities of {{main_product}} towards {{new_customer_segment}}. Compare with current customers and determine the main benefits of entry. Rank the opportunities as high, medium, or low priority.
output_format: Return only a JSON array with the format: [{"segment": "Segment 1", "priority": "High", "value": 0},{"segment": "Segment 2", "priority": "Medium", "value": 0},{"segment": "Segment 3", "priority": "Low", "value": 0}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: New Types of Products

prompt_template: Using the data of {{main_product}}, analyze growth opportunities in related products such as {{related_products}}. Identify consumption patterns in {{consumer_segment}} and possible combinations with the existing offer. Generate a ranking of products with the highest potential and show their projected market share.
output_format: Return only a JSON array with the format: [{"product": "Product 1", "projected_share": 0},{"product": "Product 2", "projected_share": 0},{"product": "Product 3", "projected_share": 0}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Customer Segmentation and Profiling
description: Perform advanced segmentation of customers based on behavior, demographics, and purchasing patterns.
prompt_template: Perform advanced customer segmentation for {{company_name}} in the {{industry}} industry, operating in {{country}}. Segment customers according to behavioral variables such as frequency of purchase, product mix, and digital engagement. Include demographic and psychographic dimensions when possible.
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the format: [{"clave": "Segment Name", "valor": {"percentage": 0, "key_characteristics": ["trait 1", "trait 2", "trait 3"]}}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Value Proposition Builder
description: Generate customer-focused value propositions based on market expectations and company strengths.
prompt_template: Generate value propositions for {{company_name}} in the {{industry}} industry, operating in {{country}}. The propositions must align with current market expectations and reflect key differentiators relevant to the {{target_audience}}. Emphasize aspects such as innovation, service quality, sustainability, and customer experience.
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the format: [{"clave": "Value Proposition 1", "valor": "description of the value proposition"}, {"clave": "Value Proposition 2", "valor": "description of the value proposition"}, {"clave": "Value Proposition 3", "valor": "description of the value proposition"}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with 'additional_information:', include a key named 'additional_information' with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Price Transparency and Competitor Benchmarking
description: Compare product or service prices with realistic market competitors based on user interests.
prompt_template: Analyze the pricing of {{product_or_service}} offered by {{company_name}} in the {{industry}} industry and compare it with {{top_x_number}} realistic competitors operating in {{country}}. Ensure that comparisons are consistent with user interests such as {{key_value_factors}} (e.g., quality, delivery, customization). Provide transparency regarding price positioning and relative competitiveness.
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the format: [{"clave": "Competitor Name", "valor": {"price_position": "string (e.g., Higher, Similar, Lower)", "price_difference": 0, "key_factor_alignment": "string"}}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with 'additional_information:', include a key named 'additional_information' with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Procurement Culture Mapping
description: Analyze the purchasing culture of customers (centralized vs. decentralized) and its implications.
prompt_template: Analyze the procurement culture of customers of {{company_name}} in {{country}}, within the {{industry}} industry. Determine the proportion of clients operating under centralized vs. decentralized procurement models. Describe key decision-making behaviors and implications for negotiation strategies.
output_format: Return ONLY a JSON object with the format: {"procurement_culture": {"centralized": 0, "decentralized": 0}, "insights": ["string insight 1", "string insight 2", "string insight 3"]}. If the user's prompt includes a section with 'additional_information:', include a key named 'additional_information' with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.

title: Churn Risk and Retention Modeling
description: Anticipate potential customer losses by analyzing churn risk and identifying retention opportunities.
prompt_template: Perform a churn risk analysis for {{company_name}} in {{country}}, operating in the {{industry}} industry. Identify the top {{top_x_number}} risk factors that contribute to potential customer losses and suggest retention strategies for each segment. Include a churn probability score for each segment.
output_format: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with the format: [{"clave": "Segment Name", "valor": {"churn_probability": 0, "main_risk_factors": ["factor 1", "factor 2"], "recommended_actions": ["action 1", "action 2"]}}]. If the user's prompt includes a section with "additional_information:", include a key named "additional_information" with the requested details as a string. Do not include this key otherwise.
